title: OSINT: Find Everything About Anyone!
description:
Join The Family:💻👩🏻‍💻https://cyberflow-academy.framer.website/
Check Out The Courses We Offer: https://cyberflow-academy.framer.website/courses

Educational Purposes Only.

OSINT is one of the most powerful skills in cybersecurity... and also one of the most misunderstood.

In this video, we're diving deep into the world of Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) and breaking down tools and techniques that can reveal shocking amounts of information from usernames, emails, social accounts, metadata, public records, and digital footprints.

We're going beyond beginner OSINT and looking at the tools that professionals actually use, the stuff hidden deep inside forums, investigator workflows, and research communities.

💻 In this video you'll learn:

• How investigators connect digital identities
• Username hunting across hundreds of websites
• Email intelligence and account discovery
• Advanced OSINT workflow techniques
• Geolocation and image investigation methods
• Investigation documentation and evidence collection
• Public records and hidden information sources
• Tools used by researchers and investigators

Tools covered:

* IntelTechniques
* Epieos
* Sherlock
* Holehe
* Hunchly
* Overpass Turbo
* OpenStreetMap
* SpiderFoot
* Public record databases

⚠️ Educational disclaimer:

This video is strictly for educational and defensive purposes. Everything shown uses publicly available information. No hacking, unauthorized access, or bypassing systems. The purpose of OSINT is understanding how information becomes exposed so you can better protect yourself and improve your cybersecurity awareness.
